Interface SimulationTemporalEvent

All Known Implementing Classes:
ClimateEvent, HistoricalEvent
public interface SimulationTemporalEvent

SimulationTemporalEvent

Universal standard interface contract for all temporal and spatial simulation events (climate cataclysms, historical milestones, leader interventions, anthropic disasters). Enforces unified monotonic linear temporal triggering, active window evaluation, and clean expiration criteria across all discrete simulation time steps.

Version:
1.0.0
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot

    • getTemporalIntensity

      double getTemporalIntensity(int currentYear, int currentMonth, int currentDay)
      Calculates the continuous temporal intensity envelope [0.0, 1.0] at the given date. Evaluates continuous smooth profiles (bell curve, exponential decay, or sigmoidal plateau).
      Parameters:
      currentYear - simulation calendar year
      currentMonth - simulation month index (0-11)
      currentDay - simulation day of month (1-30)
      Returns:
      normalized intensity multiplier between 0.0 and 1.0
